name: vibesdk-user-api-lambda
description: API Gateway HTTP API (v2) Lambda handler for user stats (worker/api/routes/statsRoutes.ts), custom model-provider listing, and model-config CRUD (worker/api/routes/modelProviderRoutes.ts, modelConfigRoutes.ts), wired to vibesdk-db-analytics, vibesdk-db-model-config, vibesdk-model-config-defaults, and vibesdk-auth-orchestration (token validation only). Not part of the main vibesdk build.

scripts.package: npm run build && echo '{"type":"module"}' > dist/package.json && cd dist && zip -r ../user-api-lambda.zip handler.js package.json
